newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HSBC designs new product on Australia wages growth.
newsitem.headline: HSBC designs new product on Australia wages growth.

text.p: HSBC Markets Australia said on Monday it has designed a new research product which will track wages growth three time more frequently than existing measures.
The first issue of the monthly report would be released on April 29, two days before the Australian Bureau of Statistics releases its quarterly report on average weekly earnings.
HSBC said no single Australian indicator would be more important to interest rates and the Australian dollar over the course of this year than the growth of wages.
"This is because accelerating wages growth may signal interest rate increases, while slowing wages growth indicate moves may need to be made to counter rising unemployment," the bank said.

The report would provide analysis of major enterprise bargaining agreements reached during the month and would include an assessment of the impact of decisions by state and federal arbitral tribunals.
It would also examine the implications of these for interest rates, exchange rates, federal politics and the macro economy.
In addition, the report would explore the implications of prospective agreements and decisions for future wages growth.
